== Biography ==
'''Henry Glasgow''' was born about 1850. He is attached as an uncertain son of [[Glasgow-3903|James Glasgow]].

Henry was living at Inishrush, County Londonderry, in December 1878. On 12 December 1878 he was present at the death of James Glasgow, a married farmer aged 84, at Inishrush. Henry reported the death and made his mark on the civil registration. The return gives his residence as Inishrush and describes him as “present at death”, but does not state his relationship to James.<ref name="JamesDeath">“Civil Records,” database with images, ''Irish Genealogy'', death of James Glasgow, 12 December 1878, Group Registration ID 5928386, Magherafelt registration district, [https://www.irishgenealogy.ie/view/?record_id=cide-5928386 indexed record] and [https://www.irishgenealogy.ie/files/civil/deaths_returns/deaths_1878/020497/7192875.pdf original civil return].</ref>

James's family gravestone identifies him as a son of Adam and Rose Glasgow but does not name Henry.<ref name="Gravestone">“Tamlaght O’Crilly Lower Graveyard,” ''One Irish Rover'', [https://www.oneirishrover.com/tamlaght-graveyard/ Glasgow family gravestone].</ref>

== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-3903]] is assessed at 32% (possible). Henry was present at James’s 1878 Inishrush death and shared his surname and locality, which makes kinship plausible. The return explicitly omits a relationship, and neither the family monument nor held life records names Henry as James’s son; the competing James identities add uncertainty.

Held citation and associated historical narrative address this selected father-child identity; no original was newly inspected.

Next useful test: Find Henry’s marriage or baptism naming his father and separating the two James identities.

Source basis already held: [https://www.irishgenealogy.ie/view/?record_id=cide-5928386 “Civil Records,” database with images, Irish Genealogy, death of James Glasgow, 12 December 1878, Group Registration ID 5928386, Magherafelt registration district, indexed record (https://www.irishgenealogy.ie/view/?record_id=cide-5928386) and original civil return (https://www.irishgenealogy.ie/files/civil/deaths_returns/deaths_1878/020497/7192875.pdf).]. No new father attached; cited evidence and any inspected register entry are scoped above.



=== Parentage ===

Henry's presence at James Glasgow's death, their shared surname and residence at Inishrush are consistent with a close family relationship, but the civil death registration does not identify Henry as James's son. The father-son relationship should therefore remain marked '''uncertain''' unless a record explicitly establishing Henry's parentage is found.

=== Birth ===

The currently cited sources do not establish Henry's birth date. The estimate of about 1850 should remain uncertain unless supported by another record.
